verdicts.reason: A breaks the message: DISCOUNT sits at the top and MERRY at the very bottom, so it reads 'Discount… Merry', and a large dead band in the middle leaves the illustrations jammed into top and bottom rows. B keeps MERRY above DISCOUNT and keeps the scattered-character feel of the original, but the headline sits off-centre to the left with the red monster and holly crowding its right edge, and the small characters and gifts in the bottom cluster overlap and press against the canvas edge.
